historical_references.reference: Ramsharan was also known as Ramananda, and is famously associated with the meeting of the great poet-saint Tulsidas and the future founder of the Sikh religion, Guru Nanak Dev Ji. This encounter is said to have had a profound impact on both Tulsidas and Guru Nanak, shaping their spiritual paths and literary works.
